conviction_note: The reported quarter was pre-guided on 2026-08-05 and the stock will trade on tonight's first FY27 guide. Management has already said FY27 brings faster revenue growth but only modest baseline EBITDA growth, against a FY27 consensus I could not source. Positioning pulls both ways: puts are bid at +24.5 vol points and 5 of the last 7 prints fell, but about 14% of the float is short with roughly 5.5 days to cover, and the stock is down 56% from its high. So p_up is 47 and abs_move is 14, which gives -0.84. The findings sum to +0.9 because the peer and positioning positives are sized on their own; the gap between the two numbers is that sign uncertainty, not a contradiction.
bar: Q4 FY26 (Jul-Sep 2026): consensus EPS $0.33 on revenue $235.7M (Earnings Whispers preview, 2026-11-10, https://finviz.com/news/420785/uti-must-prove-its-guidance-cut-was-an-execution-stumble-not-a-demand-problem). A stale pre-cut aggregator figure of $0.41 / $248M also circulates (MarketBeat forecast page) and should be ignored. The company guide implies the quarter: FY26 revenue $893-900M less 9-month $661.2M gives Q4 $231.8-238.8M. FY26 net income $32-36M less 9-month $15.5M gives Q4 $16.5-20.5M, roughly $0.30-0.37 a share. FY26 adj. EBITDA $100-103M less 9-month $59.5M gives Q4 $40.5-43.5M. FY26 starts 31,900-32,300 less 9-month 19,360 gives Q4 12,540-12,940, against 12,109 in Q4 FY25 (+3.6% to +6.9%). Source: Q3 release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001261654/000126165426000015/exhibit991-q32026earningsp.htm and supplement https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001261654/000126165426000015/q32026financialsupplemen.htm. Consensus sits at the midpoint of the guide. The FY27 bar is UNSOURCED: the only FY27 EPS estimates found are Northland's pre-cut $0.86-0.87 from March-May 2026. Findings that depend on the FY27 bar are therefore capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest is about 7.7M shares, about 14% of shares outstanding, with about 5.5 days to cover, up about 12.7% month on month (Equibles, settlement 2026-11-13, https://equibles.com/stocks/uti/shortinterest). ShortSqueeze showed 6.82M shares and 4.1 days on 2026-11-06 (https://shortsqueeze.com/?symbol=UTI). Benzinga shows 13.9% of float, rising (https://benzinga.com/quote/UTI/short-interest). In May 2026 it was 10.83% of float at 2.6 days (MarketBeat). The baseline's 25-delta skew is +24.48 vol points (downside paid), ATM IV is 186%, the event-implied move is 12.77% and put/call OI is 0.95. The tape is 56% below the 52-week high, 21.6% above the low, +8% over 20 days and -2.4% over 5 days. So there is a crowded, rising short and a put-heavy skew on a stock already down 56%: two-sided squeeze risk.

findings.finding: The reported quarter is already pinned by the guide cut of 2026-08-05: the guide implies Q4 revenue of $231.8-238.8M (consensus $235.7M), Q4 EBITDA of $40.5-43.5M and Q4 starts of 12,540-12,940 (+3.6% to +6.9% y/y against 12,109). The only fresh in-quarter data points are positive: UTI-Atlanta's first start was about 30% ahead of plan and UTI-San Antonio was about 40% ahead of its launch model.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the Nov 2025 Q4 print the stock beat the quarter and still fell 20.45% on the guide. On Aug 2026 it beat consensus EPS ($0.04 vs $0.01) and fell 34.22% on the guide cut. Beats of the quarter have not been paid on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced, because the company told the market the quarter with six weeks of it left, and consensus sits at the guide midpoint. A miss outside the range would be new, but the guide was set late in the quarter. The campus outperformance is in the press releases and the Earnings Whispers preview.
findings.independence: The campus figures come from the Earnings Whispers preview of 2026-11-10 (https://finviz.com/news/420785/uti-must-prove-its-guidance-cut-was-an-execution-stumble-not-a-demand-problem), a different document from the release. The guide arithmetic rests on the company release alone.

findings.finding: Tonight is the first FY27 guide (management said on 2026-08-05 it would set FY27 guidance 'in November' with Q4) and management has pre-framed it. FY27 revenue growth is to be higher than FY26's (FY26 guide about +7%, so FY27 revenue lands near $965M or more). Baseline adj. EBITDA growth is only 'modest' off a FY26 baseline of about $135M. There will be 'some carry-in impact from the high school miss', and four campus openings (UTI Salt Lake City; Concorde Houston, Atlanta and Glendale AZ) keep growth spending high, with $100M or more of annual capex. Against a FY27 EPS consensus that may still carry pre-cut estimates ($0.86-0.87 Northland), the reported EPS and EBITDA guide risks landing below the Street, as the first FY26 guide did in Nov 2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The first FY26 guide in Nov 2025, judged below forecast, took the stock down 20.45% despite a Q4 beat. The Aug 2026 guide cut took it down 34.22%. The Feb 2026 print fell 11.16%. Guidance has been the line that moves this stock, and it has moved it down.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced, since the stock has fallen 56% and management said 'modest' publicly. If the Street had fully absorbed it, FY27 EPS estimates would sit near the FY26 guide of $0.57-0.64 plus modest growth, and none newer than the pre-cut $0.86-0.87 were findable. The FY27 bar is unsourced, so this is capped small.
findings.independence: This shares the Q3 call transcript with the mix-shift finding. The Earnings Whispers preview (https://finviz.com/news/420785/uti-must-prove-its-guidance-cut-was-an-execution-stumble-not-a-demand-problem) independently lists four FY27 campus openings and $110M capex. The pre-cut Northland FY27 estimate is reported by MarketBeat (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/research-analysts-issue-forecasts-for-uti-fy2026-earnings-2026-05-08/).

findings.finding: The closest peer, Lincoln Educational (LINC), reported on 2026-11-09, after UTI last spoke and for the same July-September quarter as UTI's Q4. LINC's Transportation and Skilled Trades starts rose 16.5% (total starts +14.2% on an aligned basis), lead conversion was back to 'historic levels' and full-year revenue guidance was raised to $600-605M. That supports UTI's claim that its auto/diesel high-school miss was execution (about 140 reps against lead flow up 15%; headcount raised about 20% to 170+) rather than demand, which matters for whether the FY27 starts guide can recover.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no clean record of how UTI reacts to a peer read. UTI's own starts beats (+11% total, UTI division +23% in Q3) were overwhelmed by the guide cut in Aug 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: A peer read is public, but UTI's 20-day run-up of +8% is modest against a 56% drawdown and bearish sentiment has doubled, which suggests the market still prices a demand problem. If it had absorbed 'industry demand intact', bearish sentiment and short interest would have fallen rather than risen (+12.7% month on month into 2026-11-13). The link is a direct competitor in the same auto/diesel/skilled-trades programs and the same high-school channel. The caveat is that strong peer starts could also mean UTI lost share in Q4.
findings.independence: UTI's own statement that high-school lead flow was up over 15% (Q3 call, https://earningswhispers.com/transcript/UTI/Q32026) points the same way. It is a different document from the LINC release.

findings.finding: The program-mix shift toward shorter, lower-revenue skilled-trades programs was about 30% (about $6M) of the cut to FY26 baseline EBITDA. It is structural rather than a one-quarter execution miss, so it can carry into FY27 revenue per start and the FY27 EBITDA guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This driver was part of the Aug 2026 cut that took the stock down 34.22%. It has no separate reaction history.
findings.why_not_priced: The market's focus has been the 'execution' story about rep staffing, which admissions hiring fixes. The mix shift does not get fixed by hiring, and the preview lists 'whether the program-mix shift stabilizes or accelerates' as an open question, so how it is treated in the guide is not known.
findings.independence: This shares the Q3 transcript with the FY27-guide finding. It is a separate fact from that document, not a second reading of the same number. The Earnings Whispers preview (https://finviz.com/news/420785/uti-must-prove-its-guidance-cut-was-an-execution-stumble-not-a-demand-problem) restates the 70/30 split.

findings.finding: Positioning: short interest rose to about 14% of shares outstanding with about 5.5 days to cover at the 2026-11-13 settlement (6.82M shares and 4.1 days on 11-06; 10.8% of float and 2.6 days in May). Bearish sentiment is 48.4%, the stock is 56% off its high and puts are bid at +24.5 vol points. A crowded and rising short into a guide management has already framed as 'modest' sets up a squeeze if the FY27 guide merely meets lowered expectations.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The two up prints in the history (+10.63% in May 2025, +4.02% in Feb 2025) came before the short build. There is no post-build squeeze in the record yet.
findings.why_not_priced: The skew prices downside, not a squeeze. If shorts saw an asymmetric squeeze risk, short interest would be falling into the print rather than rising.
findings.independence: ShortSqueeze, 2026-11-06 (https://shortsqueeze.com/?symbol=UTI), and Benzinga, 13.9% of float and rising (https://benzinga.com/quote/UTI/short-interest), are different vendors pointing the same way.

findings.finding: Financing: on 2026-08-18 UTI replaced its $125M revolver with a $200M five-year senior secured facility to 2031, from Fifth Third, JPMorgan, Truist, Citi and PNC, plus $75M uncommitted incremental capacity. It funds the North Star campus build (FY26 capex about $110M, FY26 adjusted FCF guided at $(20)M to $0) with five banks committing after the guide cut. The ramp it funds is corroborated by new campuses running 30-40% ahead of their launch models, so it reads as a small positive or a zero, not distress.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior financing event in the reaction history.
findings.why_not_priced: It was public in August. The only new information tonight is whether the FY27 FCF guide shows the revolver being drawn.
findings.independence: The campus outperformance in the Earnings Whispers preview (https://finviz.com/news/420785/uti-must-prove-its-guidance-cut-was-an-execution-stumble-not-a-demand-problem) corroborates the use of the money.

findings.finding: Director Robert T. DeVincenzi made two open-market purchases after the August collapse: about 1,000 shares at $25.95 on 2026-08-12 and about 1,000 shares at $21.77 on 2026-08-25 (roughly $48K in total). These are small and come from an aggregator; Form 4s were not checked.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no record of how the stock reacts to insider buying.
findings.why_not_priced: It is too small to matter to the price, and Benzinga reports insider sales of about $128M over the same 90 days, mostly by the holder Coliseum.

outside_window.finding: The Education Department's earnings-test final rule (fact sheet of 2026-06-29) applies to undergraduate certificate programs, which make up most of UTI and Concorde's offering. The first calculation comes in early 2027 for the 2027-28 award year, so any program failures land after the exit window.
Investor Campus Day at UTI-Atlanta on 2026-12-17, with management Q&A. At maturity the campus is expected to serve over 1,500 students a year and generate more than $40M in annual revenue.

baseline_tension: The guidance-risk negatives agree with the +24.5 put skew and the name's 5-of-7-down history, so they are largely priced. The peer read and the rising 14% short cut against the skew, which is why p_up sits near 50 rather than at a firm down lean.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6: the reported-quarter finding lands inside the company's own guide, so it moved from +0.5 to +0.3.
Lesson 7: a crowded and rising short (~14%, 5.5 days) shrank both guidance negatives, FY27 guide from -1.5 to -1.2 and mix shift from -0.8 to -0.6. p_up moved from 46 to 47.
Lesson 6: the FY27 bar is unsourced, so the guide finding stays capped small, as already drafted.
Lesson 4: financing asked what the money buys (a campus ramp running 30-40% ahead of plan), so it stays a small positive.
Lesson 1: the quarter's beats are not paid on this name, which was already reflected; abs_move stays at 14 on the guidance scale.
